x: In what was for us a not too encouraging afternoon's sport, Chris Steer stood out. Only 18 years of age, he was 15th out of 46 finishers and beat in such men as Phil Vivian, Ken Honney and Geoff Winchester.

In the Surrey County '20' at Banstead on May 2nd Charlie Walker seemed all set to win the Championship when,in the last half mile,Walton's Geoff Winchester shot past with a strong finish and a bewildered Charlie had to be content with 2nd place.
